scope: offline verification lifecycle and publication review corrections

commands.evidence: Empty output after final source and documentation changes; repeated after evidence generation and staging.

source_and_output_review.rule: A failed or unacknowledged verification command cannot be automatically replayed by polling or recovery. Explicit correction must use the existing same-session control and execution boundary.
boundaries_checked: separate provider success and workflow stop
already queued and new PR recheck
regressions: failed verification prevents GitHub publication and leaves exact evidence
interrupted verification blocks replay while lost publication replies reuse verified evidence
failed remote verification survives polls and restart, settles workflow and permits explicit correction
cancellation during verification fences publication and retains verification evidence
source_and_output_review.observed: Failed command executed once over multiple coordinator ticks and restart; one collected result and no automatic continuation. Provider success remains succeeded with exit 0 and cost null while workflow is needs-human/result-verification. One explicit resume continues the same session and preserves the blocked old run. Successful verification is not replayed after a lost publication reply.

source_and_output_review.rule: Publication evidence must describe the exact committed revision from a clean index/worktree; uncommitted or verification-created commits must never be silently published or discarded.
boundaries_checked: status read failure and invalid status
regressions: verification tracked writes block publication at the unchanged native Git head
verification staged writes block publication at the unchanged native Git head
verification untracked writes block publication at the unchanged native Git head
pre-existing dirty files and unavailable status fail closed even with an empty Verify list
verification-created commits are retained and blocked instead of publishing stale evidence
pushed results and post-push publication use the same clean-checkout boundary
verified publication recovery rejects changed heads, dirty trees and missing evidence without command replay
source_and_output_review.observed: Native isolated Git repositories retain each tracked, staged and untracked mutation at an unchanged applied head, record successful command exit 0, stop before the next command, and publish nothing. Verification-created commits retain the changed head but block stale evidence. Status failures fail closed.

source_and_output_review.rule: Public result reads expose the recorded workflow stop without private artifact payloads or provider operations.
source_and_output_review.observed: Inspected the generated result endpoint response: HTTP 200, blocked/verification-failed, exit 2, one artifact summary, zero provider calls, no files payload.

external_qualification.remedy: Complete the independent native preparation adapter and its limited-authority evidence before registry integration. Later production transports require implemented adapters, credentials, demonstrated model access and authorized bounded live evidence; preserve model/provider defaults and sandbox permissions.
